en.title: Suspected sabotage attempt at Dormagen substation
en.summary: The police are operating at a substation in Dormagen-Gohr. Sensitive items were found there.

bn.title: ডরমাজেন সাবস্টেশনে সন্দেহভাজন নাশকতার চেষ্টা
